author: Dadrian
body:
On 15th February, 2015 I was banned for 'using aimbot'.
My current Minecraft username is SatsujinPai.
I did not even use aimbot, my cat stepped on my computer mouse, constantly clicking it. Making the bow shoot arrows. 
My friend and I love the server, but she's been sad because I'm banned from it.
Many thanks.
